name: decision-card
title: Decision card
description: One question from the agent, with answers to pick, rank or rewrite, and Skip or Continue.

props.name: hint
props.description: A muted line under the title, e.g. "Select up to 5".

props.name: value
props.description: radio: the chosen value. checkbox / chips: the chosen values. ranking: every value in order. draft: the text. summary: the values to list.

props.name: max
props.description: chips: how many can be picked.

props.name: draftTitle
props.description: draft: the bold first line of the draft, e.g. the subject.

props.name: onRewrite
props.description: draft: called when Rewrite is pressed, after the field becomes editable.

props.name: continueLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `continue` label, or `useReply` on a draft.

props.name: previousStepLabel
props.description: The step navigator's previous button. Defaults to the `previousQuestion` label.

props.name: nextStepLabel
props.description: The step navigator's next button. Defaults to the `nextQuestion` label.

props.name: children
props.description: A body of your own, in place of the type's answers; it moves with the step.

props.name: footer
props.description: Actions of your own, in place of Skip and Continue, in the footer row (not on a draft).

DecisionItemPreview.description: A static `decisionItem` row in its hover state, for state sheets.
